# Agent marks from Omarchy

These SVG files are copied unchanged from Omarchy's built-in **Agents** bar plugin
(`omarchy.agents` 1.0.0, author Omarchy, license MIT), as installed by the `omarchy` package
4.5.0 at `/usr/share/omarchy/shell/plugins/agents/assets/` (source: https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy,
packaged from https://github.com/omacom/omarchy). Omarchy's MIT licence is in `LICENSE` beside them.

`scripts/import_omarchy_icons.py` turns them into the account-icon marks in
`herdr_attention/ui_contract.json` (`account_icons.glyphs`, each with `"source"` naming its file). The
page and the bar panel draw those paths in the account's theme colour; the files here are the
reference copy, not loaded at run time.

The marks are the trademarks of their companies (Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, Google, xAI, GitHub, ...).
They are used here only to name which service an account belongs to.
